note: City of Humboldt campground in Camp Hunter park at the southwest corner of town: shaded gravel loops beside the playground and picnic shelters, with the city wastewater plant just to the south. --Claude
summary: City page (live 2026-11-06): 17 electrical hookups, shower house, free wi-fi, $10/night, permit from City Hall or the Water Plant after hours - fees, count, showers, wifi confirmed; water cleared (city page silent, aggregators only); amperage unstated. Still open on Google (4.5/20). Not waterfront confirmed; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' confirmed: imagery (300 m frame) shows the gravel loops in a wooded park; the Neosho River is ~250 m west behind a tree nursery and forest, and the wastewater plant's ponds just south are treatment lagoons.
PIN 37.80285,-95.44590 equals OSM's caravan_site node (capacity 17) and sits in the park's gravel loops; fine. Google's place pin (37.80469,-95.44571) is ~200 m north at the park's north end.

HOOKUPS: the city says '17 electrical hookups' without an amperage, so electric is left unwritten; The Dyrt says 30 A and Campendium 20 A (they disagree). Water at the sites and a dump station appear only in aggregators, so the derived water value was cleared.

OPEN: Google Maps shows the place open, 4.5 stars from 20 reviews, phone 620-473-3232 (= stored, City Hall on the city page). Website as stored is the city's live parks page; Google still links the dead humboldtkansas.org/camp_hunter.html.
BOOKING: permit purchase only (City Hall / Water Plant); no reservation channel on the city page, so reservable/fcfs left unset.
